preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of magnets n must be between 3 and 2000.
The total number of magnets across all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output must be in the format '! k A' where k is the number of demagnetized magnets and A is their indices.
The number of indices in A must match the reported number of demagnetized magnets k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for a in A)
postconditions.description: All indices in A must be within the valid range of magnet indices.
